NOTE: More than likely the shader class is going to be decoupled from the scene (I should be able to choose which shader I'm using at a given time to draw a scene). RIght now this is a simple approach due to some coupling with uniform naming that is set from inside the model.
Will be fixed once I find a more univeral uniform naming convention. Or how uniforms are generically handled without all this coupling.
